summary: Tested entity_communications (Integradores + Nuevos Productos) backend + frontend end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest passing. Frontend: data-testids, autocomplete, template dropdown, dialog, send button and communications pages all working.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapping <tr> inside <tbody> creates 'span cannot be a child of tbody' / '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' console errors. Likely caused by visual editor wrapper (data-ve-dynamic). Cosmetic console noise only — not breaking the table render.

critical_code_review_comments: entity_communications.py: bitacora 'date' is sliced from ISO string (now[:10]) — correct UTC date but no second granularity in 'date' field; second granularity is preserved in created_at/email_data.sent_at as required (ISO with T).

entity_communications.py supervisor check uses cargo in ('Gerente','Director','Supervisor') — broad supervisor heuristic; if business intends strict hierarchy mapping consider an explicit supervisor_user_id chain check in the future.
Files are well-sized (<450 lines each), inputs validated, MongoDB _id excluded with projection, env vars used. No critical issues.
seed_data_creation: TEST_doc_pytest (entity_documents, deleted), TEST_tpl_integradores_*/TEST_tpl_nuevos_productos_* (email_templates, deleted), TEST_pytest * (bitacora + new_product_evolution notification entries created during send-email tests — sent to test_recipient@example.com / test_np@example.com, status simulated)

rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues. Test had to send full EmailTemplate body on PUT (422 if partial); fixed in test. Pre-existing hydration warning in QuotesTable/Integrators table is caused by visual-editor span wrapper around <tr> rows, unrelated to this feature.
